source: PROVISIONAL curated set (40, 4x10), shipped under the maintainer's 2026-11-23 direction '심볼 목록은 일단 구현해 보고 사용성을 평가하면서 개선해보자' — evaluate in use, then improve; not a final ruling. Starting curation: the emoji subset of symbl.cc's popular collection (site register, NOT Korean chat — a Korean chat corpus would re-rank; docs/DESIGN-ANDROID-SYMBOL-GESTURES.md §5). Prior art for the bundled-curated option: open-keyboard's fixed local catalog (6 categories, no downloads), HeliBoard's bundled category files (docs/ANDROID-KOREAN-IME-SURVEY.md §6). The system-picker bridge and a full panel remain the open alternatives. Variation selectors (U+FE0F) kept for emoji presentation. App-read frontend data (KP11): the engine never loads this file.

x-notes.contract: tools/symbol-data-check.py checks structure (10 per row, 1-2 codepoints with U+FE0F the only allowed second, no duplicates, the mode row); content provisional. Entries are STRINGS (❤️ is two codepoints) — SymbolScreen.parse(multiChar=true).
